title: Man dies after airport arrest
article: The province's Special Investigations Unit is hoping an autopsy will reveal why an airline passenger suddenly died after being arrested by police at the Ottawa airport Sunday.

The police watchdog said Monday that Stephane Michaud, 43, had just arrived on a morning Air Canada flight from Halifax when airport staff and passengers noticed him yelling and acting in a strange manner in the arrivals area.
Several Ottawa Police officers subdued and handcuffed the man and placed him onto a stretcher. He went into "medical distress" while being treated by paramedics.

Michaud was taken to hospital, where he was pronounced dead. An autopsy was conducted Monday in Ottawa, although the results were not expected until Tuesday. "His personal behaviour was very bizarre," said SIU spokeswoman Kaia Werbus, who declined to elaborate any further on how the man was acting.
